## "I'm stuck and frustrated"
Say so — early and out loud. If you are stuck, someone near you almost
certainly is too. Getting unstuck quickly is the whole point of having
instructors and TAs in the room.
:::

## Introductions

Take **10 seconds** to introduce yourself. Please share:

- Your name
- Where you work
- Your current go-to method for analysing data

## Let's make this workshop work for all

::: {.callout-important}
## You belong here
This workshop is intended for a wide audience with a focus on beginners. If you
feel out of place — you are not. Everyone in this room was a beginner at
something recently, including the people teaching.
:::
